description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ElementDef, which stores an HTML element definition used by the HTMLPurifier library for HTML sanitization. Contains properties and methods for managing element attributes, content models, and merging definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ElementDef
classes.description: Represents an HTML element definition with properties for attributes, content models, and methods for merging definitions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new standalone element definition with specified content model, type, and attributes.

methods.name: mergeIn
methods.description: Merges another element definition into this one, with precedence rules for attributes and properties.

methods.name: _mergeAssocArray
methods.description: Helper method to merge two associative arrays, removing entries with false values.
